# Security reports

This project is a public test application. Security maintenance is focused on the current source and test release; no support commitment is made for older versions.

Use GitHub's **Security → Advisories → Report a vulnerability** when private reporting is enabled for this repository. If that option is unavailable, open an issue requesting a private reporting channel without including vulnerability details.

Please keep exploit instructions, passwords, authentication tokens, identity files, private join bundles and other sensitive data out of public issues. A useful private report identifies the affected release, prerequisites, reproduction steps, impact and any proposed fix.

Publisher signing is not currently available. A valid signature on the bundled third-party driver does not sign the launcher or private VLA service. Verification results and known limits are recorded in the source documentation.
